body: Camera Op at transit stop bench 07:42. Tyler arrives 07:47. 11 min, no conversation. NOOR-1 logs 28.7 Hz composite at T+4:00 full amplitude. New canon: 28.7 Hz = interference pattern between them, not either one's frequency. Sealed log Entry 23 amended (first Series X amendment). Activation #130.
title: Build 0126: S00E02 'Arrival' — first proximity, 28.7 Hz composite standing wave, Camera Op in Pontiac
